result.summary: The image shows a narrow, one-way residential street with continuous sidewalks and mature street trees. While the narrow roadway geometry likely encourages slow driving speeds, the pedestrian environment is constrained by narrow walkways and significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a very narrow sidewalk that is significantly obstructed by large covered objects. The presence of high-profile parked vehicles directly adjacent to the walkway further constrains the space and limits visibility between pedestrians and the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Large items covered in tarps occupy a significant portion of the already narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on the very edge of the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center-left on the sidewalk area

hazards.name: Substandard Sidewalk Width
hazards.description: The sidewalk is too narrow to allow two people to pass comfortably or to accommodate mobility devices, especially given the obstructions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked at the curb creates a visual barrier between the sidewalk and the travel lane, increasing risk for pedestrians stepping into the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to provide a clear, unobstructed path of travel that meets accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement and enforce policies to prevent the storage of private property, such as motorcycles or equipment, on the public walkway.
